The Desk has four ideas. Once you have them, every other page is a detail.

## The four ideas

### A Solution

A **Solution** is an agent, a team or a workflow that you mark as ready to be used by others. The Desk shows only Solutions. See [What a Solution is, and how to mark one](/docs/introduction/what-a-solution-is/).

Marking a Solution is not enough to show it: you also [publish it to the Desk](/docs/desk/publish-solutions-to-the-desk/).

### A seat

Every person has a **seat**:

- A **Studio seat** is for people who build. They also see the Desk.
- A **Desk seat** is for people who use. They open the Desk, and nothing else.

The two seats are counted apart in your plan. See [Seats and rights of the Desk](/docs/desk/seats-and-rights-of-the-desk/).

### A conversation

When a person asks a Solution for work, a **conversation** starts. It shows the work as it goes, asks the person what it needs, and keeps the result. A conversation belongs to the person who started it. Nobody else sees it, unless the person shares it.

### A cockpit

A **cockpit** is the starting page of a department. It says what the department is for, offers its Solutions, shows what waits for people, and can show figures from your Data Tables. You build it in the Studio. See [Build a cockpit](/docs/desk/build-a-cockpit/).

## What happens when someone asks for work

1. The person writes what they need in the Desk, or starts from a suggestion or a cockpit.
2. The Desk starts the Solution they chose, and a conversation opens.
3. The conversation shows the work. If the Solution needs an answer or an approval, the conversation moves to **Waiting for you**, and the person may be e-mailed.
4. The person answers. The work goes on.
5. The result stays next to the conversation, saved with it.

The execution is also in **Executions** in the Studio, where a builder can follow it step by step.

## Who sees what

| | Person on a Desk seat | Person on a Studio seat |
|---|---|---|
| The Desk | Yes | Yes |
| The Studio | No | Yes, according to their roles |
| The Solutions | Those published to the Desk that their rights let them see | The same in the Desk; all they may see in the Studio |
| The conversations | Their own, and those shared with them | The same |
| The cockpits | Those with at least one Solution they see, or with no Solution | The same, and they can build them with the right to make cockpits |

## Each person has their own Desk

- Nobody sees the conversations of another person, except those shared with them.
- Titles, pins, archives and groups are yours. On a shared conversation, each person keeps their own.
- Everything the Desk shows updates by itself, without reloading the page.
